title: Introduction to Professional Practice
description: Introduction to workplace professional practice expectations in preparation for Humanities co-op work terms. Includes preparation of cover letters and resumes, skills assessment and analysis, networking and interview skill development and career planning.
notes: May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
